_meta.role: Computer Vision & Machine Learning Engineer, Photon-Efficient Event-Driven Imaging

summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY building computer vision and machine learning systems in PyTorch, TensorFlow, C++ and Python. Built monocular depth estimation and wavelet-denoised imaging pipelines (PSNR 86, ±8% depth error) at BARC, and trained and deployed YOLO detection models (83% mAP@50, 5.2× TensorRT speedup) on edge hardware.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Developed a custom image-stitching pipeline for high-resolution generation using bit manipulation and averaging, achieving a PSNR of 65 compared to homography-based stitching baseline.

Designed a custom wavelet bank (alpha-blended sym6+bior3.5) for statistical signal processing of low-frequency noise suppression; combined with optimized homography stitching and concurrency to achieve a PSNR of 86.
Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.
Architected a full metal surface inspection pipeline for microscopic crack analysis using custom image stitching, wavelet denoising, and depth estimation.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) on a custom medical billing dataset for structured field extraction.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via improved preprocessing and model tuning.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated faster-whisper STT (1.0–1.4s), Gemini intent classification (<500ms), TensorRT-optimized YOLO detection and tracking (5.2× speedup: 56.7→10.9 ms, 17.6→92 FPS vs eager PyTorch) for visual servoing, and dual VL53L0X ToF sensors (camera range-gate + gripper-ToF-triggered close at 25 mm) for contact-aware grasping via TCA9548A I2C mux.
Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Built automated data generation pipelines using CARLA's semantic segmentation and raycast occlusion filtering to produce ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD training frames with zero manual annotation.
Trained YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD (ResNet-18) with SoftmaxFocalLoss + ParsingRelationLoss; integrated into an adaptive control stack with lane-following and waypoint fallback.

projects.name: Frame Simulator — Desktop 3D Coordinate-Frame Visualizer
bullets: Built a PySide6/Qt desktop GUI with an OpenGL-backed VisPy 3D viewport to visualize coordinate-frame hierarchies, parent-child transform chains, and SE(3) poses in real time.

Wrote a custom DSL parser and SE(3) math engine (math_se3.py) supporting local/world rotation and translation composition, recursive world-transform chaining, and live 4x4 matrix inspection per frame.
